name: suppyhq
description: Use your SuppyHQ support inbox from Codex. Read conversations, draft replies, send or save them.

interface.shortDescription: Work your support inbox from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Read conversations and customer history, draft replies in your own voice, and send them or leave them as drafts for a human to approve. Requires the SuppyHQ CLI (suppyhq) installed and on your PATH.
